admin.noAccess: Administration is only available to teachers, trainers and admins.

organization.name: Name
organization.domainHelp: Becomes part of the username: name{'@'}domain
organization.domainChangeHelp: Note: changing the domain changes all usernames.

setup.title: Set up Klonk
setup.description: Create your school or company and the first admin account.

users.initialPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters – must be changed on first sign-in.

login.description: Choose how members of your organization sign in. Several methods can be active at the same time.
login.localDescription: Accounts are created here in the admin area.
login.oidcDescription: E.g. Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IServ, Keycloak or Authentik.
login.ldapDescription: Sign in with the school or company password via the directory service.
login.callbackUrlHelp: Register these addresses as allowed redirect URIs at your identity provider.
login.roleClaimHelp: Optional. Map values below to roles, one per line – everyone else becomes a student/employee.
login.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the stored value.
login.userFilterHelp: {'{{username}}'} is replaced by the entered name.
login.oidcLocked: Single sign-on via OIDC is part of the license. LDAP and password accounts are free.

license.description: Without a license Klonk runs as the free version: up to 10 accounts, one character, the standard models, sign-in with password or LDAP and no libraries.
license.tokenHelp: You get the token in your customer account after purchase.
license.tokenReplace: A token is stored – a new one replaces it.
license.fromEnv: The license is set via the NUXT_LICENSE_TOKEN environment variable.
license.ownerOnly: The license is managed by the operators of this installation.

problem.wrong_domain: Token is not valid for this domain

limit.warning: {used} of {max} accounts used – the license limit will be reached soon.
limit.over: The limit of {max} accounts has been reached. {left} more accounts can be created, after that an upgrade is required.
limit.blocked: The limit of {max} accounts has been reached – new accounts only after an upgrade.

ai.description: The AI assistant helps with programming: it explains errors, answers questions about the code and gives hints. Choose which language model your organization uses.
ai.locked: The AI assistant is part of the license.

modeDescriptions.off: No AI assistant for this organization.
modeDescriptions.server: Requests go through the Klonk server to your provider (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio …). The key stays on the server.
modeDescriptions.webllm: The model runs on the device (requires WebGPU, one-time download of about 1–2 GB). No data leaves the device.

ai.serverHelp: Any service with an OpenAI-compatible interface (/chat/completions) works.
ai.baseUrlHelp: Base URL including /v1, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://ollama:11434/v1
ai.apiKeyHelp: Optional (e.g. not needed for Ollama). Stored encrypted.
ai.webllmHelp: The model weights are downloaded from Hugging Face the first time the assistant is opened and stored in the browser. Requires a browser with WebGPU (Chrome, Edge).
ai.tutorDescription: The assistant explains and gives tips but does not write finished solutions. Teachers and admins always get full help.

errors.cannot_change_self: You can't lock or change the role of your own account here.
errors.no_login_method: At least one sign-in method must be active.
